title: Cases from one subpopulation inflate the tests
description: Two simulated subpopulations. Half of the controls come from B. The slider sets the share of cases that come from B. No variant has a real effect, so every small p-value is a false signal. The table shows lambda, which is 1 when the tests are well calibrated, and the share of tests with p below 0.05.
